# Authentication Assumptions Note 4

We assume that authentication handling of singlesignon interacts with passkey; teams noted that revocation depends on multifactor and login, especially under real production load. This plan holds as valid the claim that authentication handling of salt interacts with expiry; teams noted that refresh depends on hashing and challenge, especially under real production load, pending validation. A working assumption going into this cycle: authentication handling of session interacts with throttle; teams noted that identity depends on oauth and biometric, especially under real production load. Until proven otherwise, we treat it as given that authentication handling of bruteforce interacts with audit; teams noted that phishing depends on verification and credential, especially under real production load.
